name: Nexora Site Toolkit
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
Nexora Site Toolkit centralizes useful site information and admin workflows in one place. It is designed for administrators who want a clear picture of their site without browsing the server filesystem.

Overview — WordPress, PHP, MySQL, database size, disk space, theme, plugins, SSL, locale, and URLs.

Content — Posts, pages, media, comments, categories, tags, and users by role.

Server & PHP — Server software, PHP extensions, object cache, REST API status, cron events, and registered image sizes.

Security — Read-only checks for SSL, file editor lock, debug mode, administrator count, and more.

Shortcuts — Quick links to native WordPress admin screens (Dashboard, Site Health, Media, Plugins, etc.).

Tools — Copy or download a plain-text site report; maintenance checklist; refresh uploads size cache.

My Nest — Private admin notes saved to your user account in WordPress (not files on disk).

Settings — Dashboard widget, admin bar link, default tab, pinned shortcuts, and uploads cache duration.

This plugin does not provide a file manager. It does not browse, upload, download, edit, rename, or delete files on the server.

Only users with the manage_options capability can access the toolkit.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nexora-site-toolkit folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu.
  3. Open Site Toolkit in the admin menu.
  4. Optional: configure pins and display options under Site Toolkit → Settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin manage files?

No. It shows read-only statistics and links to standard WordPress admin pages.

Where are My Nest notes stored?

In your WordPress user meta, private to your account.

Who can use the toolkit?

Users with the manage_options capability.
